process: A person is colouring in a pencil drawing of a tower, autumn trees and landscape with a red marker, filling in the sketched areas one part at a time.

stages.state: tower outlined, upper segments uncoloured, marker at the tip
stages.prompt: A close-up of a hand holding a red marker above a pencil drawing on white paper. A tall tower with grey outlined segments and red bands on its lower section stretches diagonally across the page, its upper segments still uncoloured. Yellow and orange autumn trees, green hills and a small grey house fill the rest of the drawing on the right.

A close-up of a hand holding a red marker above a pencil drawing on white paper. The tower now has red fill across its upper segments as well, and the marker tip rests on its top section. Yellow and orange autumn trees, green hills and a small grey house fill the right side of the drawing.

stages.state: whole tower red-banded, marker moved to house
stages.prompt: A close-up of a hand holding a red marker above a pencil drawing on white paper. The whole tower is now coloured in red bands from base to tip, and the marker has moved down to the small grey house on the right, its roof still uncoloured. Yellow and orange autumn trees and green hills surround it.

stages.state: house roof red, nearby tree crowns touched red
stages.prompt: A close-up of a hand holding a red marker above a pencil drawing on white paper. The tower is fully coloured in red, the small house roof is now filled in red, and the nearest tree crowns carry fresh red strokes among the yellow leaves. The marker rests near the house.
